dreamteamer.title: Tasks
dreamteamer.description: `tasks`: concrete commitments with owners, dates, tags and source links. Default Board and List show suggested, todo, doing and blocked work. Older inbox, by-person and Gantt routes remain accessible without extra navigation entries. The working-with-tasks skill manages the existing lifecycle; no records are migrated by this display update.
